runtime_gate.first_evidence: Preserve first meaningful planning/content evidence plus first draft; direct mode is allowed when a separate plan would be fake work.
runtime_gate.judgment: Whole-essay semantic judgment is Chat-mediated; no fake local scoring and no default model-answer reveal.
runtime_gate.pass_rule: Acceptable work can PASS with no repair debt. Repair is not created for polish, style preference, or merely being less advanced than a model.
runtime_gate.repair_rule: Use the earliest meaningful failure sufficient to explain important downstream effects, apply the smallest useful repair, and require learner re-generation.
runtime_gate.cascade_rule: If the upstream repair succeeds, a later problem may become the next first failure only when it remains independently evidenced.
runtime_gate.transfer_rule: Same-prompt repair success is repair evidence, not transfer closure. Successful repair creates TRANSFER_PENDING only when a reusable high-value target is explicitly admitted; otherwise it ends REPAIR_COMPLETE without manufactured durable debt.
runtime_gate.true_exam_policy: The runtime cold-start owner contains one synthetic Small and one synthetic Big task and consumes no protected true-exam task.
runtime_gate.private_state: First evidence, Chat returns, repair evidence, transfer candidates, and attempt history persist only in the learner browser and are not written to GitHub Current.

writing_v1.runtime_target: Prompt -> first meaningful plan/content -> first draft -> PASS/ACCEPTABLE or earliest meaningful failure -> smallest sufficient repair -> learner re-generation -> later fresh Writing transfer.
writing_v1.protected_exam_rule: Cold-start mechanics and first integrated output use synthetic material. Protected true-exam tasks are not consumed merely to teach the mechanism.
